//AllowedHosts: Replace * with the API's real hostname before going live.
//Cors: MUST be the exact scheme+host+port of the deployed frontend. An empty list means every browser call fails CORS; AllowAnyOrigin is not usable because the refresh cookie is credentialed.
//Jwt: Key is deliberately absent. Supply it as the environment variable Jwt__Key (min 32 bytes). Startup fails fast with a clear message if it is missing.
//RefreshTokenCookie: Secure must stay true off localhost. Set SameSite to None only if the frontend is on a different site to the API - None also requires Secure.
//Bootstrap: Credentials are absent on purpose. Supply Bootstrap__SuperAdmin__Email and Bootstrap__SuperAdmin__Password as environment variables for the first boot against an empty database; the bootstrap is idempotent and never creates a second Super Admin.
